info.name: infinite_drift_stars_ar
info.description: Smoothly scrolling diagonal starfield with 5 depth layers and parallax. Stars are colored across a magenta→purple→blue→cyan→green palette by ID. 20% of stars are designated audio-reactive: each listens to a specific frequency bin and "clicks" into a bright glow halo on transients. The remaining 80% twinkle gently independent of audio. Subtle background nebula wash and edge vignette complete the depth.
